channel.title: 0xelitesystem new repos
channel.description: New open-source tools and references from 0xelitesystem. All MIT, all self-contained.

item.title: dst-ambiguous-time-converter
item.description: Paste a column of naive local timestamps and an IANA time zone to find every row that falls in a DST gap (never existed) or fold (happened twice), with its UTC value under the Temporal, Python and PostgreSQL rules, before you migrate the data.

item.title: date-format-pattern-translator
item.description: Paste a date format pattern and see what it prints under UTS 35, date-fns, moment, POSIX strftime and .NET for a date and region you pick, then get the equivalent pattern in each, including the late-December week-year trap where `YYYY` prints next...

item.title: filename-and-path-limits-reference
item.description: Which characters, names and lengths Windows, macOS and Linux each refuse, what MAX_PATH 260 really limits, and why a name legal on one system fails in the zip, the build or the git clone on another.

item.title: version-range-translator
item.description: Paste one version range and see how npm, Cargo, Composer, PEP 440 and RubyGems each read it, as plain comparators tested against versions you list.

item.title: punycode-idna-converter
item.description: Convert internationalized domain names to and from Punycode and see where one typed name becomes two DNS names: Python's built-in idna codec turns faß.de into fass.de, while the WHATWG URL Standard that browsers follow turns it into xn--fa-hia.de.

item.title: line-endings-and-gitattributes-reference
item.description: A plain-language reference for the three line ending problems every mixed Windows and Linux team hits: Git warning that LF will be replaced by CRLF, a script failing with `/bin/bash^M: bad interpreter`, and a diff where one edit marks every line c...

item.title: form-vs-smtp-email-validator
item.description: Paste email addresses and see whether the browser's type=email rule, RFC 5322 and RFC 5321 each accept them, which rule decided each verdict, and the quoted form SMTP needs when they disagree.

item.title: whatwg-rfc3986-url-parser-differential
item.description: Paste URLs and see, field by field, where your browser's WHATWG URL parser and a strict RFC 3986 grammar disagree on host, userinfo, port and path, including strings one accepts and the other rejects.

item.title: crontab-dialects-reference
item.description: The same cron string fires on different days in Linux cron, Quartz, Spring, AWS EventBridge, GitHub Actions and Kubernetes. A side by side reference to field counts, day-of-week numbers, the day-of-month OR day-of-week rule, time zones, daylight s...

item.title: cors-preflight-checker
item.description: Enter a cross-origin request's method, headers and credentials mode plus the server's preflight and response headers, and see whether the Fetch Standard sends a preflight, which step fails, the header change that fixes it, and where shipping brows...

item.title: exit-codes-and-signals-reference
item.description: What Linux exit codes 126, 127, 137, 139 and 143 mean, which signal each 128+N code encodes, and why the number alone cannot tell an OOM kill from a stop timeout, a kill -9, or a code the kubelet wrote itself.

item.title: scim-patch-evaluator
item.description: Paste a SCIM User or Group and a PATCH request and see the resource after every operation under a literal reading of RFC 7644, beside what Microsoft Entra's documented request shapes intend.

item.title: solebidder
item.description: Type a federal contractor and see who actually buys from it, how concentrated that book is, and

item.title: photontax
item.description: How much of your latency is physics, and how much is your route?

item.title: auditrail
item.description: The audit trail your coding agents already wrote, priced at list, ranked by what to fix, and scanned for leaked secrets, entirely on your own machine. It reads the session logs that are already there and tells you what the work was worth, where th...

item.title: github-actions-expression-evaluator
item.description: Evaluate a GitHub Actions `${{ }}` expression against a context JSON and see every type cast the runner applied, including the four casts where the runner disagrees with JavaScript.

item.title: sqlite-column-affinity-auditor
item.description: Paste CREATE TABLE DDL from any dialect and see the type affinity SQLite actually assigns each column, which literals silently change storage class on insert, whether a STRICT table would accept the declared type, and which columns are true rowid ...

item.title: ics-calendar-builder-and-validator
item.description: Calendar .ics validator and builder. Paste an .ics file and see RFC 5545 findings grouped MUST, SHOULD and note, or build an event file folded correctly at 75 octets. Single file, offline.

item.title: quantile-pooling-auditor
item.description: Paste raw latency samples from two or more shards and see how far the mean of the shard p95 values, and the traffic-weighted mean of the shard p95 values, land from the real pooled p95.

item.title: http-message-signature-base-builder
item.description: Rebuild the RFC 9421 (HTTP Message Signatures) signature base from a raw HTTP message and its `Signature-Input` header, line by line, with the rule that produced each line. RFC 9421 only: the obsolete draft-cavage scheme, whose `Signature` header ...

item.title: minified-stack-frame-resolver
item.description: Paste a production stack trace and its source map, get the original file, line and column for every frame, with the off by one column correction applied and every frame it changes flagged.

item.title: string-literal-escape-auditor
item.description: Paste one string literal with its quotes and see it evaluated under six escape grammars at once, per source span, with the disagreements marked.

item.title: repo-listing-auditor
item.description: Paste a list of repository names and see how the collection reads at listing depth: which first hyphen tokens are concentrated, and which sorted neighbours collide as one unreadable block. A slug echo check runs alongside and finds nothing here.

item.title: pdf-merge-and-split
item.description: Merge, split, reorder and rotate PDF pages entirely in your browser. Parses the real cross reference chain, names every file it refuses, and lists per file the structures it does not carry across before you download.

item.title: extension-manifest-permission-surface
item.description: Paste a browser extension manifest and a list of URLs, and see per manifest key which URLs are granted and via exactly which match pattern, resolved entirely in your browser.

item.title: electron-appid-uninstall-guid-calculator
item.description: Compute the Windows uninstall GUID, registry keys and installer mutex that electron-builder's NSIS target derives from an appId, entirely in your browser.

item.title: signing-cert-expiry-planner
item.description: A single-file browser tool that turns a Windows code signing certificate's validity dates into the dates you actually have to act on: when each untimestamped artifact goes dark, when every future renewal falls, and the last safe day to ship a brid...

item.title: claude-shipping-plugins
item.description: A Claude Code plugin marketplace for the parts of shipping software that fail

item.title: mcp-state-token-designer
item.description: Design the binding set that goes inside an MCP `requestState` token, mint one with real WebCrypto HMAC-SHA-256 in the browser, then read the residual table: which attack each binding stops, and the one attack that none of them stop.

item.description: A catalogue of five 2026 platform changes that reached working code without ever

item.title: eval-peeking-planner
item.description: Measure what checking an eval mid-run does to your false-positive rate, then compute the paired sample size and the group-sequential boundaries that fix it. Monte Carlo plus recursive numerical integration, in one HTML file, with no libraries and ...

item.title: mojibake-inverter
item.description: Paste text that an encoding mistake mangled, recover the original exactly, see the full set of codecs that could have caused the damage, and get the positions that cannot be recovered at all.

item.title: mcp-header-annotation-validator
item.description: Paste an MCP tool definition and find out, clause by clause, whether a conforming Streamable HTTP client will silently delete it from `tools/list` because of an `x-mcp-header` annotation.

item.title: yaml-type-coercion-auditor
item.description: Paste YAML and see every scalar that resolves to a different type, or a different value, depending on which parser reads the file.

item.title: staged-rollout-cohort-simulator
item.description: Runs the electron-updater staged rollout formula against freshly generated install ids and shows that a staged rollout is a fixed cohort, not a rotating sample.

item.title: electron-release-matrix-auditor
item.description: Paste a GitHub Actions workflow. It reports which release artifacts the matrix legs will fight over, and whether two legs can create two draft releases for one tag.

item.title: ai-deletion-and-retention-reference
item.description: Where user data actually lives in an AI stack, what deleted honestly means in each store, and the two places a delete request cannot reach: trained weights and immutable backups.

item.title: span-offset-debugger
item.description: Paste text and a span, name the system that produced the offsets and the one that reads them, and see the same numbers select four different substrings.

item.title: mcp-server-privilege-inventory
item.description: Paste an MCP client config and get a privilege inventory: which servers launch a subprocess as your user, how mutable each code reference is, and which secrets you hand each one.
